'''Sean's Tale''' is the local inn in [[Ostin Falls]].

==Appearance==

Sean's Tale is normally a fine place to find [[gleeman|gleemen]] and wandering storytellers, but it starts to be quieted due to the [[Seanchan]] occupation on [[Toman Head]] and the hostilities between [[Tarabon]] and [[Arad Doman]] reducing the amount of trade in the region.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>

==Activities==

[[Lorwyn Kilvar]] frequents the inn when he tries to escape his marriage to [[Meka Antos]].
